description: Layer 1 trigger pack for project idea evaluation that can turn into phased scaffolding, stack selection, and project setup artifacts.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Be brutally honest about this startup idea, and if it survives scaffold the project plan and CLAUDE.md for me.
shouldTrigger.reason: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Critique this project idea hard and then lay out phased implementation plus OpenSpec files if it is viable.
shouldTrigger.reason: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldTrigger.prompt: I have a SaaS idea. Validate whether it is worth building and sketch the initial project blueprint.
shouldTrigger.reason: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Analyze this new product concept and give me the phases before we start coding.
shouldTrigger.reason: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldTrigger.prompt: I need a critical take on this app idea and, if it holds up, the project setup plan.
shouldTrigger.reason: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Is this AI bookkeeping product worth building? If yes, scaffold the plan and stack choices.
shouldTrigger.reason: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Pressure-test this project concept and then turn it into a phased build plan.
shouldTrigger.reason: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Think through this startup idea end to end and prepare the initial project artifacts.
shouldTrigger.reason: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Evaluate this business idea and outline the implementation phases and repo conventions.
shouldTrigger.reason: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldTrigger.prompt: Tell me if this project idea survives scrutiny and what the scaffolded roadmap would look like.
shouldTrigger.reason: Project idea evaluation plus scaffolding request.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Audit our upgrade funnel end to end: competitor patterns, product gaps, UX friction, and a roadmap for what to build next.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /feature-audit: Broad feature analysis with gaps, competitor context, and roadmap.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Review this diff for runtime bugs, security issues, and broken logic. Keep false positives low.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /quick-review: Fast code review of a diff or PR.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Do a deep pre-release review of this branch with security, correctness, and architecture lenses.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /deep-review: Heavy multi-perspective code review request.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Find the real bug in this flaky payment flow, prove the root cause, fix it, and add a regression test.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /deep-fix: Root-cause-first debugging and verified fix request.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Generate unit tests for src/orders.js and follow the repo's Vitest style.
Analyze this branch diff and give me a deploy checklist: env vars, migrations, new workers, and breaking changes.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /release-check: Deploy or ship-readiness checklist request.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Create a draft PR for this branch with a concise title, summary, and affected areas.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /create-pr: Explicit request to open or draft a PR or MR.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Scout the best external skills for this repo and explain which ones we should import first.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /skill-scout: Scout external skill catalogs for relevant imports.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Give me a v0.dev prompt for redesigning the analytics dashboard.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /v0-design: Explicit request for a v0.dev design prompt.

shouldNotTrigger.prompt: Design the subscription pause workflow inside our existing product and compare approaches before implementation.
shouldNotTrigger.reason: Routes to /feature-design: design work for one existing feature, not a new project idea.
